Warfarin increases the risk of bleeding, including epistaxis, in this 55-year-old man with atrial fibrillation who is taking warfarin.

snippets.output: Posterior nasal packing is used for posterior epistaxis or when anterior packing fails; given the anterior location of bleeding in this 55-year-old man with active bleeding in the anterior nares, posterior nasal packing is not the initial step.
